summary: A 1px rule dividing related groups inside one surface.

pairs.dont: Put a rule between two cards.
pairs.do: Use it inside a surface, between sections of the same card or menu.
pairs.why: Things that already have their own surface are already separated. A rule between them adds a line and no meaning.

pairs.dont: Reach for a rule to create a gap.
pairs.do: Use spacing, and add the rule only if the grouping is still unclear.
pairs.why: Whitespace groups as well as a line does and leaves the page quieter. A rule is for when space alone has stopped working.

pairs.dont: Set decorative={false} on every rule so it is 'accessible'.
pairs.do: Leave it decorative unless the rule is the only boundary marker.
pairs.why: Headings, lists and landmarks already carry the grouping. "Separator" announced between every section is noise, not access.

pairs.dont: Drop a vertical rule into a block container and expect a line.
pairs.do: Put it in a flex row, or give it a height.
pairs.why: It fills the height it is given. Given none, it is 1px wide and 0 tall — nothing at all.

pairs.dont: Rule every row of a list.
pairs.do: Rule between groups, and let rows sit on spacing alone.
pairs.why: A line per row turns a list into a table and makes the one meaningful boundary impossible to find.
